relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: After EA intervention, the PWLD, the expression of Iba-1, CD68 mRNA and TLR4 protein of the microglia were significantly decreased

relationships.subject: electroacupuncture
relationships.evidence_quote: while the content of spinal dynorphin and the expression of KOR mRNA of the microglia increased in the EA group relative to the model group

relationships.subject: JDTic
relationships.evidence_quote: After injection of KOR inhibitor, the PWLD and expression levels of Iba-1, CD68 mRNA and TLR4 protein were significantly increased

relationships.subject: spinal microglial KOR
relationships.evidence_quote: the activation of KOR of microglia may be a target for inhibition of microglial TLR4-induced pro-inflammatory signaling

key_findings: Electroacupuncture reduced microglial TLR4 and activation in nerve-injured rats and raised dynorphin and KOR.
KOR inhibitor JDTic reversed EA effects on TLR4 and thermal latency.
